body:
**🥜 Welcome to PeanutSMP 🐌**
We are a safe and friendly SMP for Java and Bedrock players. We focus on building a welcoming community where players can make friends, build freely, and enjoy a relaxed, no-grief experience.

Running on the latest version, PeanutSMP offers vanilla-style gameplay enhanced with quality-of-life features such as player warps, chest shops, and a server shop. Our world is always expanding, giving you plenty of space to explore, build, and create.

Join today to receive a free rank, earn rewards by voting, and rank up through gameplay. Everyone is welcome.
